Components

Button

Triggers an action or event — the primary way users commit to a decision in Halo UI.

stable
Since 1.0.0 A11y: WCAG 2.2 AA · keyboard + SR verified Source: packages/react/src/Button/Button.tsx Figma ↗

The Button component triggers an action — submitting a form, opening a dialog, or confirming a destructive operation. For navigation, use a Link styled as a button instead; a real <button> should never change the URL.

Anatomy

A button is composed of an optional start icon, a label, and an optional end icon, inside a pressable target that is always at least 40×40px.

tsx
<Button>Default</Button>
<Button tone="brand">Brand</Button>
<Button tone="danger">Delete</Button>

Variants

variant controls emphasis; tone controls meaning. The two are orthogonal, so you can have a soft danger or an outline brand.

tsx
<Button variant="solid">Solid</Button>
<Button variant="soft">Soft</Button>
<Button variant="outline">Outline</Button>
<Button variant="ghost">Ghost</Button>

One solid per view

Reserve the solid brand button for the single most important action on a screen. Everything else should step down to soft, outline, or ghost.

Sizes & states

tsx
<Button size="sm">Small</Button>
<Button size="md">Medium</Button>
<Button size="lg">Large</Button>
<Button loading>Saving</Button>
<Button disabled>Disabled</Button>

Props

PropTypeDefaultDescription
variant'solid' | 'soft' | 'outline' | 'ghost''solid'Visual emphasis of the button.
tone'brand' | 'neutral' | 'danger''brand'Semantic meaning, mapped to color roles.
size'sm' | 'md' | 'lg''md'Control height and horizontal padding.
loadingbooleanfalseShows a spinner and sets aria-busy.
iconStartReactNode—Icon rendered before the label.
iconEndReactNode—Icon rendered after the label.
fullWidthbooleanfalseStretch to fill the inline container.
disabled*booleanfalsePrevents interaction; not focusable.

Usage

tsx
import { Button } from '@halo-ui/react'

<Button tone="danger" variant="soft" onClick={remove}>
  Delete project
</Button>
vue
<script setup>
import { HaloButton } from '@halo-ui/vue'
</script>

<HaloButton tone="danger" variant="soft" @click="remove">
  Delete project
</HaloButton>
html
<button class="halo-button halo-button--soft halo-button--danger">
  <span class="halo-button__label">Delete project</span>
</button>

Guidelines

Do

Lead with a verb: "Save changes", "Invite member", "Publish".

Don't

Use vague labels like "OK", "Submit", or "Click here".

Do

Place the primary action on the right in a dialog footer.

Don't

Stack two solid brand buttons of equal weight side by side.

Accessibility

  • Renders a native <button> — focusable, Enter/Space activated, announced as a button by screen readers.
  • loading sets aria-busy="true" and disables pointer + keyboard activation so the action can't fire twice.
  • Focus shows a 2px --halo-focus-ring offset by 2px, meeting the 3:1 non-text contrast requirement against every surface.
  • Icon-only buttons must pass an aria-label.

Don't disable the only path forward

A disabled submit button gives no feedback about why it's disabled. Prefer keeping it enabled and surfacing a validation message on click.
